URL: https://gvwire.com/2026/05/21/trump-demands-irans-uranium-and-no-tolls-on-hormuz-ships/ (via Reuters)
TITLE: Trump Demands Iran's Uranium and No Tolls on Hormuz Ships
PUBLISHED: 2026-05-21 18:58 UTC
SOURCE: Reuters

KEY:
- US and Iran stuck Thursday over opposing stances on uranium stockpile and Hormuz controls
- Pakistani-led mediation efforts continuing

TRUMP (White House Thursday):
- "We will get it. We don't need it, we don't want it. We'll probably destroy it after we get it, but we're not going to let them have it" (on Iran HEU)
- "We want it open, we want it free. We don't want tolls. It's an international waterway." (on Hormuz)
- Ready to resume strikes "if not get right answers" from Iran leadership

KHAMENEI:
- Issued directive: enriched uranium should NOT be sent abroad (2 senior Iranian sources to Reuters)
- Said abandoning enrichment was "100% against the country's national interest"
- Issued directive BEFORE Trump's comments

RUBIO:
- "Some good signs" in talks
- "I don't want to be overly optimistic... So, let's see what happens over the next few days"
- On Hormuz tolls: "It would make a diplomatic deal infeasible if they were to continue to pursue that. So it's a threat to the world if they were trying to do that, and it's completely illegal"

IRANIAN POSITION (Thursday — Deputy FM):
- Restated Tehran's claims to sovereignty over the strait
- Said aggression from US/Israel/regional states had "fundamentally altered security in the waterway"

TEHRAN'S LATEST OFFER (per Reuters):
- Largely repeats terms Trump previously rejected:
  - Control of Strait of Hormuz
  - Compensation for war damage
  - Lifting of sanctions
  - Release of frozen assets
  - Withdrawal of US troops

CONTEXT:
- Iran's top peace negotiator Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf Wednesday: "obvious and hidden moves by the enemy" showed Americans preparing new attacks
- Trump pared back demands to focus on preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapon (not full dismantling)
- Iran insists nuclear program is for civilian purposes only
- ISW May 21: nuclear weapons + Strait of Hormuz remain two "sticking points" (both US and Iranian officials)

ISRAELI POSITION:
- Israeli officials told Reuters: Trump assured Israel that Iran's HEU stockpile will be sent out of Iran
- Any peace deal "must include a clause on this"
- Still unclear whether Trump will decide to attack and whether he would give Israel "green light" to resume operations
- Tehran has vowed "crushing response if attacked"
